title: Detailed ice cream cone
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- cone -->
  <polygon points='50,96 32,48 68,48' fill='#D98A3C'/>
  <!-- cone waffle lines -->
  <line x1='38,50' y1='66' x2='62,50' stroke='#B36A22' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <line x1='42,66' y1='82' x2='62,62' stroke='#B36A22' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <line x1='46,82' y1='94' x2='60,80' stroke='#B36A22' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <line x1='38,60' x2='62,60' stroke='#B36A22' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.6'/>
  <line x1='43,74' x2='60,74' stroke='#B36A22' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.6'/>
  <line x1='47,86' x2='57,86' stroke='#B36A22' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- cone rim lighter -->
  <rect x='31' y='45' width='38' height='6' rx='3' fill='#F0A85A'/>
  <!-- bottom scoop: strawberry pink -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='20' fill='#F47FA0'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='46' r='9' fill='#F47FA0'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='46' r='9' fill='#F47FA0'/>
  <!-- strawberry swirl shading -->
  <path d='M36 36 Q50 50 64 36' stroke='#E85C86' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- middle scoop: mint green -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='26' r='17' fill='#7FE6C0'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='31' r='8' fill='#7FE6C0'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='31' r='8' fill='#7FE6C0'/>
  <!-- drizzles on mint -->
  <path d='M40 22 Q46 30 52 22' stroke='#4FCBA0' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M50 30 Q56 38 62 30' stroke='#4FCBA0' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- top scoop: chocolate (deep warm brown/purple) -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='13' fill='#8C4A6E'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='18' r='7' fill='#8C4A6E'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='18' r='7' fill='#8C4A6E'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='9' r='8' fill='#8C4A6E'/>
  <!-- chocolate highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='11' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#B06A92'/>
  <!-- cherry on top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='6' r='5' fill='#FF3B4E'/>
  <circle cx='48.5' cy='4.5' r='1.5' fill='#FF9AA6'/>
  <!-- cherry stem -->
  <path d='M52 2 Q57 -4 62 1' stroke='#4FA84A' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- sprinkles -->
  <rect x='44' y='33' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FFE45C' transform='rotate(20 46 34)'/>
  <rect x='54' y='38' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#5CC9FF' transform='rotate(-30 56 39)'/>
  <rect x='36' y='40' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FF8A3C' transform='rotate(40 38 41)'/>
  <rect x='60' y='44' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#B07CFF' transform='rotate(10 62 45)'/>
  <rect x='46' y='44' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FF5CA8' transform='rotate(-15 48 45)'/>
  <rect x='52' y='22' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FFE45C' transform='rotate(50 54 23)'/>
  <!-- drips -->
  <path d='M33 48 Q34 54 37 50 Q39 56 42 50' stroke='#F47FA0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 48 Q62 55 65 49' stroke='#F47FA0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
